equip_instructions: Before pitching any track, read its passport. Cite ONLY fields stamped DOCUMENTED, with their source.
Refuse to assert any field stamped PENDING. If asked, answer: 'that field is PENDING — the provider is listed in the passport.'
Brief outbound with the machine-readable passport: paste the track's passport fields into the pitch context.
No one-stop or pre-cleared rights claims are made for any track. Sync posture on every passport: 'Label-direct licensing; happy to work through your clearance process.' Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com.
The Compass is advisory tooling only. A licensed attorney still executes, advises, and signs.
